about: Harvey A. Steinberg, a managing partner in the Denver, Colorado law firm Springer and Steinberg, P.C., specializes in criminal law, white collar criminal defense, professional negligence law and personal injury law and appellate law. Mr. Steinberg has earned recognition as a skilled criminal defense trial attorney who has tried cases in federal, state and appellate courts, with reported cases. Over the course of a 40 plus year legal practice, he has regularly represented professional athletes, politicians, entertainers and businesspeople in the most serious types of cases throughout the United States.

Lawyer Harvey Steinberg began his career serving as a deputy district attorney for the 18 th Judicial District in Colorado, from 1978-1985, before turning to the private practice of the law. He has been selected for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America guide every year since 2007; has been named as an AV Preeminent* attorney for the outstanding practice of law and his high ethical standards; and he has been designated by his legal peers for inclusion in the peer-reviewed Colorado Super Lawyers listing every year since its inception in 2006.

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell peer review ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards.
